about: Coquitlam is in Metro Vancouver’s northeast, between Burnaby and the Coast Mountains. Town Centre has grown into a high-rise node on the Millennium SkyTrain line. Parks, lakes, and the Coquitlam River sit against a steep mountain backdrop. About 150,000 people live in Coquitlam.
seoSummary: Northeast Metro Vancouver city of Town Centre high-rises, lakes, and mountain parks.
